import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
cameras = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the style for seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot to explore the relationship between megapixels and price
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter_plot = sns.scatterplot(data=cameras, x='megapixels', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', style='has_video_4k', palette='deep', s=100)

# Set plot title and labels
scatter_plot.set_title('Megapixels vs Price of Digital Cameras by Sensor Type and 4K Video Capability', fontsize=16)
scatter_plot.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=14)
scatter_plot.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=14)

# Place the legend
scatter_plot.legend(title='Sensor Type & 4K Video')

# Save the plot to a file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
